newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CNT names HSBC advisor in unit spinoff.
newsitem.headline: CNT names HSBC advisor in unit spinoff.

text.p: CNT Group Ltd said on Monday it had appointed HSBC Investment Bank Asia Ltd to advise on the proposed separate listing of its bus operations.

"However, the timing of the proposed separate listing or the financial terms on which it might be carried out are still under discussion and no final decision has been reached," the company said in a statement.
The company said "an advance booking form has recently been submitted to the stock exchange".
CNT director Wu Hong Cho said a proposal concerning a possible issue of loan notes to raise capital for expansion of the bus operation had been terminated in view of the listing proposal.
CNT had earlier mulled a spin off of its 77-percent owned transportation subsidiary Citybus Ltd.
